user.title: EZVIZ Camera
user.description: Enter the appKey / appSecret of your application created on the EZVIZ Open Platform: {open_url}

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The EZVIZ credentials are invalid or changed. Please enter the appSecret again.

init.title: EZVIZ options
init.description: Free EZVIZ Open Platform accounts are limited to about 10,000 API calls, 1,000 snapshots and 50-200 AI requests per day. Choose reasonable intervals.

data.deviceserial: Show only the following devices (serial numbers); leave empty to show all devices
data.switchs: Enabled switch entities (each enabled entity consumes one API call per refresh)
data.enable_webhook: Enable webhook callback (receive EZVIZ cloud alarm pushes)
data.webhook_url: Webhook URL (auto-generated; copy it to the EZVIZ Open Platform message push configuration)

capture.name: Capture
capture.description: Take a fresh snapshot and refresh the camera image.

humandetect.name: Human detection
humandetect.description: Run human detection on the given image and return the cloud result.

picurl.name: Image URL
picurl.description: Accessible URL of the image to analyze (call the capture service first to get one).

operation.name: Operation
operation.description: number: count people; rect: bounding boxes.
